Name: Quark Drive
Effect: While Electric Terrain is active, or if this Pokémon is holding an Energy Booster; increase this Pokémon's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense or Special Defense by 1. If their highest stat is Dexterity, Defense or Special Defense increase it by 2, instead. Unique Ability.
Description: This Pokémon is energized to a sub-atomic level, its power barely contained. A power grid could destabilize their electron charge out of this dimension.
